english: Let $\overrightarrow{a}$ and $\overrightarrow{b}$ be vectors such that $|\overrightarrow{a}|=2$, $|\overrightarrow{b}|=3$ and $\overrightarrow{a}\cdot\overrightarrow{b}=4$. Define the vectors $\overrightarrow{c}_{1},\overrightarrow{c}_{2},\overrightarrow{c}_{3},\ldots$ by $\overrightarrow{c}_{1}=\overrightarrow{b}$ and $\overrightarrow{c}_{n+1}=\overrightarrow{a}\times\overrightarrow{c}_{n}$ for every integer $n\ge 1$. Then the value of $\left|\overrightarrow{c}_{2}+\overrightarrow{c}_{3}+\overrightarrow{c}_{4}+\overrightarrow{c}_{5}\right|^{2}$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $\overrightarrow{a}$ तथा $\overrightarrow{b}$ ऐसे सदिश हैं कि $|\overrightarrow{a}|=2$, $|\overrightarrow{b}|=3$ तथा $\overrightarrow{a}\cdot\overrightarrow{b}=4$ है। सदिशों $\overrightarrow{c}_{1},\overrightarrow{c}_{2},\overrightarrow{c}_{3},\ldots$ को $\overrightarrow{c}_{1}=\overrightarrow{b}$ तथा प्रत्येक पूर्णांक $n\ge 1$ के लिए $\overrightarrow{c}_{n+1}=\overrightarrow{a}\times\overrightarrow{c}_{n}$ द्वारा परिभाषित किया जाता है। तब $\left|\overrightarrow{c}_{2}+\overrightarrow{c}_{3}+\overrightarrow{c}_{4}+\overrightarrow{c}_{5}\right|^{2}$ का मान ______ है।
solution_full: Every $\overrightarrow{c}_n$ with $n\ge2$ is a cross product with $\overrightarrow{a}$ as the first factor, so $\overrightarrow{c}_n\perp\overrightarrow{a}$ for $n\ge 2$.

Since $\overrightarrow{c}_2\perp\overrightarrow{a}$, the angle between them is $\dfrac{\pi}{2}$ and $|\overrightarrow{c}_3|=|\overrightarrow{a}||\overrightarrow{c}_2|\sin\dfrac{\pi}{2}=2\sqrt{20}$, so $|\overrightarrow{c}_3|^2=80$.
originality_note: New: an iterated cross-product sequence c_{n+1} = a x c_n; from the second term on it lies in the plane perpendicular to a, so the map squares to -|a|^2 and the four-term sum collapses to -3(c2+c3) with c2 perpendicular to c3 (way 1, iteration). Closest known: a x (a x b) expansion and |a x b| from Lagrange. Different because: the iteration, the period-two behaviour and the orthogonality of consecutive terms decide the answer.

concept_use.Application of cross product: c_{n+1} = a x c_n is perpendicular to a and to c_n, its magnitude is |a||c_n| when c_n is perpendicular to a, and a x (a x v) = -|a|^2 v gives c4 = -4c2, c5 = -4c3.
concept_use.Lagrange’s Identity in Vectors: |c2|^2 = |a x b|^2 = |a|^2|b|^2 - (a.b)^2 = 36 - 16 = 20, the starting magnitude of the whole chain.

stem_review: Read as a student: every vector, line and point is introduced before use, every condition is stated, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed independently with sympy and numpy, is unique and equals the Answer Plan. Checked that the sequence is defined for every n, that the data |a| = 2, |b| = 3, a.b = 4 are consistent (|a.b| <= 6), and that the sum starts at c2. Changed: No change.
key_step: Seeing that c_n is perpendicular to a for n >= 2, so a x (a x c_n) = -4 c_n and the sum collapses to -3(c2 + c3) with c2 perpendicular to c3.
justification: Two ideas linked: Lagrange's identity for |a x b| and the vector-triple-product behaviour of the iterated map, with an orthogonality observation at the end. Similar demand to the unit-vector data question 2021-P1-Q19 (L3); harder than the direct cross-product matching of 2025-P1-Q16 (L2).
